core_rule: No implementation, modification, evaluation, or milestone transition may begin until the latest project state, canonical source, handoff, integration contract, milestone-specific frozen contracts, measured results, and roadmap have been actually read and their hashes verified.
on_failure: STOP. Restore from canonical archive or Google Drive; otherwise report the missing or inconsistent item to the user. Never infer missing implementation details.

receipt_freshness.rule: Newest receipt must match current Git HEAD and PROJECT_STATE. Preflight receipts bind work to the current milestone; transition receipts authorize one declared promotion commit and then become stale.

p2_specific_guard.rule: P2 may extend P1 only through the frozen P0 body port and P1 material-tissue contract. It must preserve the equal-material control logic and keep no-recurrence, no-prediction, no-plasticity, and no-tissue ablations.
p2_specific_guard.known_negative_result: The P1 predictor learned its local time series but did not establish positive net behavioural value; P2 must not assume prediction is beneficial.
